reason: Conversation 1 reached the correct airflow-restriction diagnosis in three concise turns, gave the right filter-wash guidance (cold water, 24h dry, no damp refit) and blockage checks up front, asked for the model, and recommended no part. Conversation 1's main gap is that it never confirmed whether the never-washed filter was actually cleaned and omitted filter washing from its closing prevention tips, which keeps the margin slight rather than clear.
